reviews.text: The staff is professional, super friendly, helpful. They always "fixed" our little kitty.
I love them so much, they treat both of our dogs with outstanding skill, whatever it takes!❤️
Quickly diagnosed and helped our puppy. Sent us home with what we needed and clear instructions. It was reasonably priced. They are very friendly and have great English.

We have been going to the clinic for 13 years with my 14-year-old large dog, who is very friendly, but could look a few years younger thanks to the doctors and assistants at the clinic. It is a friendly, good-natured and considerate clinic.

I took my dog ​​for a Cushing's test. When I made the appointment, the doctor said that my dachshund couldn't eat all day. When we went for the first blood test at 9 am, they said that he could eat without any problems.... So I paid now - 56,000 HUF unnecessarily...??? The other: I paid by card and asked if I would receive the bill by email or in person? "Well, when we get the results, we'll discuss how to proceed..." .. So they figure out an amount and I pay that ...???!! I would like to request the bill by email !!!
The ultrasound here didn't show that Buddy has pancreatitis, but at the animal hospital it did....if they noticed it here, he would still be alive....I will never bring an animal here again!

The doctors are very, very good, conscientious, and professional.
I could list the positive things.
I can only recommend it..

Incompetent company. They just want a lot of money. They mistreated my dog ​​(they treated him for kennel cough with pancreatitis), they saved his life elsewhere. They didn't even apologize.

Answer: They treated Floki for three days, but during that time they didn't recognize kennel cough. His condition worsened day by day, and by the end he couldn't even stand up. They sent him from the clinic to a veterinary hospital, saying that he was beyond recovery and would probably have to be put down.
However, at the hospital, they suspected kennel cough at first glance, even before a detailed examination. He was given the necessary medicine, and within 15-20 minutes his condition improved dramatically: he was interested in his surroundings again and could eat. He left happily on his own two feet!!!
It is still incomprehensible to me that while this diagnosis was not made in three days at one place (he was there for hours over three days), the problem was recognized almost immediately at the hospital.
This incident deeply shook me. I took Floki to the clinic with complete trust, and three years later it still hurts to think back on how I saw him suffer for days. Fortunately, he received the right treatment in time at the hospital, which saved his life.

I am a loyal type. When I inherited Mackó from my father 6 years ago, I went back to the veterinary clinic there, Pet Vet, in Pesterzsébet, for another 2-3 years. The last time they didn't notice his sudden, very serious condition and treated it incorrectly, which almost cost him his life. I had to rush him to the animal hospital on the weekend to have surgery, which cost a fortune.
Mackó is unfortunately old, he has had a heart condition for 3 years and has serious joint problems.
He receives very good medications for both of his illnesses, we finally managed to find the liquid on his two hind legs (Joy2Run) that you can pour on his food and he eats it, he doesn't get disgusted by it.
Now he is in a very good mood again, he runs like a rabbit and his appetite has returned.
My favorites among the doctors are: Dr. Dominika Kiss and Dr. Márta Magyar. Both are very kind and very professionally prepared.
Very friendly

We've been going there since it opened, but now I only have the most basic things done there. They have no idea about my dog, as if they've never seen him before. We asked for a breeding 8 days ago. I paid 36,000 HUF and they said 3-4 days. I got tired of waiting, I called them. No results yet, maybe next week. Let me be understanding. The dog will either die or heal on its own in that time. No compensation. Just a little bit of a shock. I paid for nothing. We're far from the promised deadline!!! Of course, the dog is a good advertising face on the clinic's website.

They have everything you need for pet support. My dog had an emergency and the veterinary team acted quickly to help him. They were incredibly kind, professional, and attentive throughout the entire process. Their careful and efficient work resolved the situation in less than 20 minutes. I have trusted them with my dog’s care since he was a puppy, and I can confidently recommend their services.

Five stars for the clinic! We had Mano spayed and left with the best experience. Everyone was incredibly kind and helpful. Special thanks for the detailed information: they told us exactly what to expect after the surgery, so we started our recovery with confidence. Mano's recovery is going great, thank you for the professional work!🩷 …

Dear Dr Kiss Dominika, is the prescription fee 1700 HUF? I leave some money for the dog every month, which I feel is seriously overpriced anyway. Did you seriously charge 1700 HUF to prescribe a diuretic for the dog? Is he really sick or do you just need the money for a greasy sandwich? I am really sick of this clinic.
I understand the answer. So if you charge 1700 HUF for 5 minutes of work, it means that you are working with an hourly rate of 20,400 HUF. Do you understand what I mean when I feel massively sick from this? Do you understand that you cannot prescribe a prescription with an hourly rate of 20,000 HUF? Do you understand at all that you cannot rip off pet owners in such a disgusting way? Do you understand that? Or do you just feel sorry for them?

This week I took my cat for the 4 or 5th time there to get the anti parasite tab! And also a nail clip. The doctor was not patient to give the tab and instead used the drop! Instead of dropping in the correct spot, she put it where the cat could lick it! Since it’s oily, after 3 days it’s still on his fur, smelling and makes the cat lick it and vomit! Now I should find another doctor to take him for solving the issue.
This happened before there that they couldn’t clip his nails and they were so harsh with my cat and trying to stop the process and not finishing the clipping process in the middle. I had 3 of the doctors there during my visits by now. All three were DISQUALIFIED. Not mentally not professionally capable of being a vet! I’ve seen great vets, and they are not among them. Unfortunately this place is nowhere you can continue taking your pets there even for very very simple matters or check up!! I’m really sorry for what they did to my baby! My little cat had sweating paws every time taking him there, what he never experienced before!! They are not kind, not responsible and not professional! Done

The assistant is very nice and I'm sure the doctors are too, but as a first-time owner, unfortunately the experience was not good. :(
I took my 4-month-old puppy to them with constant diarrhea and vomiting, where they really only prescribed medication and an appetite stimulant. Based on the reviews, I was confident that we had come to the right place, but the symptoms did not go away. I called and we went back, but they did not take a blood or stool sample, he only received medication.
After a month and a half of financial loss/stress and going to the hospital, I found a good doctor and it turned out that the puppy had salmonella.
Very nice, good doctor and assistant. We brought in a pretty bad patient 😄 Prices are not too high. I recommend it to all owners! …
They are always kind and have an extremely positive attitude towards both the animal and its owner. I recommend them to everyone!

Great clinic.
Even my little fluffy dachshund is welcomed and treated with extraordinary love.
Thank you for your persistent and conscientious work!

I haven't had any negative experiences with them so far, but I haven't had any major problems with my cat either, I just had to take him for routine things. The only "negative" I've noticed so far is that it's a bit bad that we always end up at random doctors, we can't choose what to see, we just have the one we get to see. So far, this has only caused problems in that sometimes we ended up with a nicer, more skilled doctor, and sometimes we ended up with a slightly less nicer, slightly less skilled doctor, but it wasn't a big problem.
However, I was very disappointed with the place this week.
I took my cat in this week because he had an abscess-like hole on his butt, it turned out that his scent gland was inflamed and burst. They treated him professionally (I think, because I haven't seen any major problems so far), but then when the doctor asked me whether I would prefer a berry or a syringe medicine for home care (antibiotics and painkillers), I told him berry because I could give him that. At first he said it was good, but then he changed his mind and said, "Oh, the berry won't be good after all, because it doesn't have the active ingredients that I need." So we bought the liquid-based one, which you have to squirt into his mouth with a syringe. In the end, I paid about 42,000 HUF for the whole thing (including the sedative), and I didn't get any detailed bill about how much it cost. I gave him the syringe medication for 2 days, which is a 2-person job with my cat, he has to be restrained, I had to call for help, it was terribly difficult to solve because I live alone and even then it was a horror every time, once the poor thing got it wrong, he coughed like he was being strangled afterwards. I wrote to them to beg them, couldn't they switch to berry medication, because this is a huge horror for everyone? To which they wrote back saying, of course, I should go in, the berry medication has the same active ingredient! I went in and a very obnoxious, passive-aggressive woman was there, I bought the berry medication and then I asked, but if this is good, then why did we get syringes in the first place when I wanted the berry one? Answer: because the doctor must have thought it was better. There is no normal explanation, so I asked about the price of the medications separately, which of course requires a mouth pull, a muzzle cut, oh my god, you have to look it up on the computer. He very reluctantly told me the prices and it turned out that the berry option is about a third of the price of the syringe ones, I tried to stay calm, but then he started saying that “most owners specifically ask for that”. I say that’s fine, but that’s not what I asked for.
It’s a huge disappointment for me to be faced with the fact that they can rip off a cat like that in a previously problem-free clinic, and adding that to the fact that I never know if we’re going to see a good or bad, kind or mouth-pulling doctor, it’s especially desperate, and combined with the mistreatment experiences I’ve read here, it’s downright scary. Now I can look for a new clinic! In the end, it might even turn out that my cat was never “too problematic” for vet visits, maybe I just took it to the wrong place.

They were very kind and thorough. You can make an appointment in advance for your planned visit, so they called you into the office almost immediately, you didn't have to wait in line in the waiting room.

I found a stray cat that needed help and straight went to this place. The vets here are truly selfless heroes. I’m always so happy and reassured to see them. They are incredibly kind, understanding, and professional. The ladies who helped my cat were absolutely amazing gentle, compassionate, and so dedicated. I’m forever thankful for their service and commitment. They go above and beyond, and it means the world to us. Thank you very much for your dedication
Great team ❤️
We have been going to them for more than 11 years! I can only recommend them.
We have been coming here with our cat Léda for years, we have no complaints about the service or the prices, and in fact, we have been coming back here since we moved further away.

We should get rid of the incompetent interns whose knowledge extends to guessing ear mites, because ear polyps haven't been taught at university yet. There must be a decent doctor here who not only barely passed the exams, but we just haven't encountered him yet.
I recommend everyone to come here knowing the diagnosis (chatgpt can tell you more precisely than the "doctors" here), maybe then the pet will have a better chance of receiving proper care. Or rather, visit another clinic, if it's not a simple vaccination or treatment.
It's outrageous that after several visits, 3-4 times they figured out what the problem could be. In the case of a more serious illness, this could cost the cat/dog its life, while they are just guessing due to their incomplete knowledge. I don't dispute their kindness and conscientiousness. However, their expertise shouldn't just extend to giving you a tissue if your pet dies because you brought it here in time and it was misdiagnosed.

Dr. Dóri is the best!!!!
Everyone does their job, to the best of their ability!
Professional team!
🫶😻 …

I love the team of this clinic! Everyone is so lovely and helpful. I am so grateful we can go here. My dog is really difficult but they are still so patient and managed him well. He got really sick and they found out immediately what his problem is and he was healthy again the same day❤️ And prices are great. Thank you so much!

A dog was operated on for pyometry, the surgery was successful. The experience is mixed, there are some very kind, animal-loving people working here, and some for whom this is less true. I do not recommend it because of the prices, they still charge extra for the advertised prices (e.g. for blood tests). The medicines are also more expensive than elsewhere. On the positive side, the well-equipped clinic, parking is quite difficult nearby. I expected more information about the animal's illness/treatment, so I find the information a bit insufficient, it would have accelerated the recovery, but overall I am satisfied, because the dog was saved. We also sought the opinion of another doctor, I think it never hurts, I recommend it in any case.

The Limp Dog's is one of the best vet clinics in town. It is very popular and is always packed. All the doctors and nurses are very friendly, and kind to animals, they offer a large variety of diagnostic procedures. Some basic medication and dietetic food can be picked up at the reception.
Good spot for foreign/non Hungarian speakers. They're able to speak English and the prices are fair
Really nice, the doctor tells me many information about the cat vaccination that I don’t know. Very helpful

I couldn't take my dog ​​to the clinic for vaccinations.
I had a delivery to my garden, apartment.
Dr. Csilla Karpati came with her assistant.
They were very kind, really pet-friendly!!
And they were extremely thorough!
They called me back before the delivery, asked me in detail about the dog, whether it had been vaccinated, had any illnesses, etc.!
I could ask questions calmly, they answered everything patiently.
I highly recommend them, it was just an annual booster vaccination and it was a fluke, but their attitude towards both the dog and the owner was reassuring.
I hope it doesn't get sick, but if it does, I will feel free to contact them because I know my dog ​​will be in good hands!
thank you
